criterion_text: Search, select, empty/error states and the **same row `···` dropdown on wide and narrow Web** are keyboard-/pointer-operable. The anchored menu exposes all four actions (`Session details`, `Edit details`, `Attach settings`, `Kill session`), retains the Session list and selected work, and dismisses by Escape/outside click/list scroll. View details reads the target Session without selecting it; edit title/description/tags reuses the current metadata owner and never renames tmux. Configure uses existing attach settings; Kill requires typed immutable tmux Session name. Offline Sessions remain discoverable, editing unavailability is explicit and no Conversation semantics are invented.

verifiers.summary: Playwright JSON confirms executed passing tests and assertions with no skips
The unified row menu adapts to the existing metadata, attach and typed-name kill owners
